title: Decision: Adding a Sales Person to the Team
goals: increase revenue, expand market reach, improve customer relationships, and establish repeatable sales process

options.title: Hire Full-Time Enterprise Sales Representative
options.description: Bring on an experienced sales professional focused on large accounts with base salary of $80-100k plus commission

options.title: Hire Junior Sales Development Representative (SDR)
options.description: Hire an entry-level sales person to handle lead qualification and pipeline building at $50-60k base salary

options.title: Continue Founder-Led Sales
options.description: Maintain current approach with founders handling all sales activities while optimizing processes

options.title: Hire Part-Time/Contract Sales Person
options.description: Engage an experienced sales professional on a part-time or contract basis to test the waters

criteria.title: Financial Impact
criteria.description: Cost of salary, commission, and benefits versus expected revenue generation

criteria.title: Market Readiness
criteria.description: Whether our product and market are mature enough for dedicated sales

criteria.title: Process Documentation
criteria.description: State of our sales playbook, materials, and onboarding documentation

criteria.title: Management Bandwidth
criteria.description: Team's capacity to train and manage a new sales hire effectively

criteria.title: Lead Pipeline
criteria.description: Quality and quantity of existing leads to support a full-time sales role

criteria.title: Cultural Fit
criteria.description: Impact on company culture and team dynamics

criteria.title: Timing
criteria.description: Alignment with company growth stage and market conditions
